en: to move forward quickly; to make a lot of progress quickly
ex: The company is forging ahead with its plans for expansion.
公司的拓展计划正顺利进行。

en: a person who makes illegal copies of money, documents, etc. in order to cheat people
the crime of copying money, documents, etc. in order to cheat people
ex: Experts are dismissing claims that the painting is a forgery.
专家排除了这幅画是赝品的说法。

zh: 不再想；不再把…放在心上
en: to not remember to do something that you ought to do, or to bring or buy something that you ought to bring or buy
ex: ‘Why weren't you at the meeting?’ ‘Sorry—I forgot.’
“你为什么没有参加会议？” “对不起，我忘了。”

en: a low-growing plant with small, light-blue flowers
often forgetting things
ex: She has become very forgetful in recent years.
近年来她变得十分健忘。

en: while forgetting something
ex: law-abiding people who forgetfully carry knives onto a plane
守法的人忘记把刀子带到飞机上

zh: the fact of tending to forget things
en: the fact of tending to forget things
ex: a moment of forgetfulness
健忘的时刻
